COHR 301.title: Business and Management Values
COHR 301.description: Balancing organizational, personal, and community interests in a global economy. In addition to standard management textbooks and readings, the class will draw from the work of poets, fiction writers, essayists, and social critics. .

COHR 302.title: Critical Evaluation of Information, Evidence, and Arguments
COHR 302.description: Strategies to critically evaluate information relevant to Human Resource Managers. This course will examine common errors in logic, decision biases, and cause and effect relationships. .
COHR 302.prerequisiteText: COMM_V 203 and one of COMM_V 191, COMM_V 291

COHR 303.title: Strategic Staffing
COHR 303.description: Processes of workforce recruitment, selection, retention, and renewal. Includes human resources planning, development of an effective staffing strategy and employer brand, job analysis and descriptions, cost-benefit analysis of various recruiting methods, analysis and evaluation of selection methods. .

COHR 304.title: Training, Development, and Performance Management
COHR 304.description: Employee training, development and performance management in a variety of employment settings. Application of various training methods to performance enhancement, performance appraisal, feedback, and empirical evaluation of training investments. .

COHR 305.title: Strategic Compensation
COHR 305.description: Employee compensation, including pay systems, benefits systems, and rewards and recognition programs. Examination of the motivational underpinnings of compensation administration and the application of compensation principles to the achievement of employer strategic objectives. .

COHR 307.title: Introduction to Organizational Consulting
COHR 307.description: Frameworks from the social sciences useful for understanding organizational processes and how to apply these frameworks to particular organizational consulting challenges. .

COHR 308.title: Labour Relations
COHR 308.description: Integrated coverage of union-management relations including labour law, collective bargaining, and collective agreement administration. .

COHR 310.title: Industrial Relations in an Era of Globalization
COHR 310.description: Comprehensive examination of the Canadian industrial relations system, and its legal foundations, in the context of a global economy. .

COHR 311.title: Organizational Analysis
COHR 311.description: An analysis of organizational structures and intraorganizational processes; effects of organizational factors on individual behaviour. .

COHR 401.title: Organizational Change
COHR 401.description: The tactics and strategies for implementing constructive modifications in organizations. .

COHR 402.title: Leadership
COHR 402.description: Explores the characteristics of effective leadership and examines how to be a better leader. .

COHR 403.title: Managing Diversity
COHR 403.description: Explores the business and legal cases for diversity in the workplace. Examines how to effectively manage a diverse work force. .

COHR 404.title: Power and Politics
COHR 404.description: Examines the sources and consequences of power in the context of different corporate and national cultures. .

COHR 405.title: Managing the Family Business
COHR 405.description: Managing and working in a family business presents unique challenges: family issues can conflict with business issues. This course examines governance structures and tools to manage the interface between the family and the business. .

COHR 406.title: International Human Resource Management
COHR 406.description: Application of human resource management practices to multinational enterprises. Comparative analysis of national human resource management systems. .

COHR 407.title: Advanced Organizational Consulting
COHR 407.description: Methods and techniques to diagnose and solve a broad range of organizational problems from the perspective of an organizational consultant. .

COHR 408.title: Organizational Design
COHR 408.description: Techniques and approaches for evaluating and adjusting the structures of organization. .

COHR 409.title: Creativity and Innovation
COHR 409.description: Techniques and approaches to managing creativity and innovation in organizations. .

COHR 410.title: Knowledge Management
COHR 410.description: Techniques and approaches to managing knowledge and learning in organizations. .

COHR 411.title: Managing and Building Teams
COHR 411.description: Techniques and approaches for building effective teams, handling decision-making in teams, creating reward structures, and developing appropriate leadership models. .

COHR 412.title: Advanced Topics in Organizational Behaviour
COHR 412.description: Understanding, critiquing, and analyzing behaviour and social processes in organizations. This course focuses on provocative and current topics that could not be covered in depth in the introductory course. .

COHR 433.title: Employment Law
COHR 433.description: Introduction to legislation and application of legal principles that govern the employment relationship. .

COHR 486.title: Special Topics in Organizational Behaviour and Human Resources
